content.text:
The pricing page now stacks the three plans in one column on phones, and the layout matches the approved phone screenshot. The page was missing `.plans` from the phone-width (`max-width: 720px`) rule that makes grids single-column in `site/css/pages.css`. I added it, and the three plan cards no longer overlap each other and the text below them.

All 28 Playwright tests pass, including the phone pricing screenshot that was failing before. I haven't committed anything.
